comparison.objective: Float-mount a print centered on a hidden riser and backing board, versus finish four threaded inserts.
comparison.physical_skill: Delicate planar alignment and mounting with hidden support versus recessed axial tool alignment, bimanual impact, and fragment search.
comparison.success_condition: Print is mounted, elevated, and centered versus four tang fractures, four contained fragments, no damage, and stable release.
comparison.reason: Precision alignment is shared only generically; mounting a sheet does not test fracture mechanics or loose-fragment recovery. Centering and elevation tolerances are missing.
